images.title: Four tiles of (5 + z)(y + 9)
images.purpose: Shows the binomial tiles in their simplest state: (5 + z)(y + 9) as a rectangle of four tiles, one per pair of terms.
images.composition: One rectangle of four tiles centred, with the bracket terms along two edges. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text.
images.exact_structure: A rectangle split into a 2 by 2 arrangement of tiles. Columns: left column wide, labelled 'y' above it; right column labelled '9' above it. Rows: top row labelled '5' to its left; bottom row labelled 'z' to its left. Tiles: top left teal (#0072B2) labelled '5y'; top right amber (#E69F00) labelled '45'; bottom left amber labelled 'yz'; bottom right reddish purple (#CC79A7) labelled '9z'. Thin dark outlines between tiles. Exactly 4 tiles.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: (5 + z)(y + 9) = 5y + 45 + yz + 9z, one term for each tile.
images.description: Shows the binomial tiles in their simplest state: (5 + z)(y + 9) as a rectangle of four tiles, one per pair of terms.

image_decisions.why: The practice tool places one tile per pair of terms; the image shows that core move in its simplest form.
